description: Add Claim, ClaimArtifact, NegativeAssertion, ClaimCorrection models to Prisma schema and implement full Claims CRUD API with conflict detection, correction flow, negative assertions API, and artifact management.
steps: Add Claim, ClaimArtifact, NegativeAssertion, ClaimCorrection models to prisma/schema.prisma exactly as specified in the user instruction schema. Maintain existing models unchanged.
Run 'npx prisma generate' to regenerate the Prisma client with the new models.

Create src/app/api/claims/route.ts with GET (list claims, filterable by status/category/claimKey, with included artifacts and negativeAssertions) and POST (create claim with validation: statement required, claimKey required, category must be one of numeric/date/attribution/capability/narrative). On POST, if claimKey already has an active claim, return 409 with both claims for user resolution.

Create src/app/api/claims/[id]/route.ts with GET (single claim with artifacts, negativeAssertions, corrections), PATCH (update statement/status/category, set updatedAt), DELETE (soft-delete: set status to 'superseded').

Create src/app/api/claims/[id]/artifacts/route.ts with GET (list artifacts for claim) and POST (create artifact with passageText required, passageLocation optional, freshnessWindow optional). Artifact creation must not mutate the claim's statement.

Create src/app/api/claims/[id]/correct/route.ts with POST that accepts { previousValue, correctedValue, source? }. This atomically: (1) updates the claim statement to correctedValue, (2) creates a ClaimCorrection record, (3) creates a NegativeAssertion with forbiddenText=previousValue. Idempotent: correcting to the same value twice does not create duplicate assertions.
Create src/app/api/claims/[id]/negative-assertions/route.ts with GET (list) and POST (manual add with forbiddenText and reason required).

All API routes must use try/catch with formatErrorResponse, generateRequestId, validationError from @/lib/api-error following the pattern in src/app/api/experience/route.ts and src/app/api/profile/metrics/route.ts.

Write unit tests in src/lib/__tests__/claims-api.test.ts that test the validation logic, conflict detection logic, and correction idempotency logic (can mock prisma). Test that category validation rejects invalid categories, that required fields are enforced, etc.
Verify with 'npx prisma generate' and 'npm run build' that everything compiles.
acceptance_criteria: All four models (Claim, ClaimArtifact, NegativeAssertion, ClaimCorrection) exist in prisma/schema.prisma with correct fields, relations, indexes, and @@unique constraint
npx prisma generate succeeds and produces typed client
POST /api/claims creates a claim and returns it with id
GET /api/claims returns list filterable by status, category, claimKey
Creating a claim with a claimKey that has an existing active claim returns 409
POST /api/claims/[id]/artifacts creates evidence without mutating the claim statement
POST /api/claims/[id]/correct atomically updates claim + creates correction + creates negative assertion
Correction is idempotent (same correction twice does not duplicate assertions)
GET /api/claims/[id]/negative-assertions returns all assertions for that claim
All routes have try/catch with error messages in response body
